title: Head and Tail
prompt: Implement head_tail(items) that returns a tuple (first, rest) where rest is a list of everything after the first item. Use unpacking, not slicing, and return (None, []) for an empty input.

tests.name: single element
tests.hint: With one element, rest is empty.

tests.name: empty input
tests.hint: Handle the empty case explicitly before unpacking.
